environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). Security group allows inbound TCP 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB, ALB forwards to port 8080. No WAF WebACL is associated with the ALB. The HMAC_SECRET environment variable is set to a known test value 'admin-test-2024' that was leaked in a public GitHub commit. The application is accessible at https://internal-tools.example.com/api/users/search.

config.database: SQLite on local EBS volume with production user data
